ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_platform.title: A place to launch
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_platform.desc: Make a &dLaunch Pad&r (iron blocks, knuffelsteen and a nibble battery) and put it somewhere open: the rocket gets big!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_romp.title: The hull
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_romp.desc: Click the pad with &d64 knuffelsteen&r, &d24 iron&r and &d16 glass&r (in portions is fine).
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_motor.title: The engine
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_motor.desc: Two &dnibble batteries&r, a &dGuh Oven&r, &d4 iron blocks&r and &d16 redstone&r. Vroom!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_brandstof.desc: &d24 blocks of cheese nibbles&r and &d4 buckets of cheese sauce&r. Rockets run on cheese, everybody knows that.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_bemanning.desc: Dress three of your guhs in an &dastronaut suit&r (wool and glass), take them to the pad and click it.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.raket_gelanceerd.des: Click the pad: countdown, engines on, and off goes the rocket!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.kaasmaan_vlag.title: One small step
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.kaasmaan_vlag.desc: Plant a &dlittle moon flag&r on the Cheese Moon. Chip &dcheese moon crystals&r in the craters and swap them with &dAstronaut Kaasje&r for souvenirs.
